cohort: The study included 84 women aged 20-28 years, weighing 55-65 kg, 145-160 cm tall, with pregnancies 38-41+6 weeks, who were undergoing lower segment caesarean section.
finding: Tranexamic acid significantly reduced intra-operative blood loss during LSCS but did not significantly reduce postpartum blood loss within 2 hours, and was not associated with any noted complications or side effects.
